done_when: A Postgres integration test sends SDK messages through the control API, durable admission, the real live worker, conversation queue, mocked Claude and OpenAI models, core and remote MCP tools, outbound delivery, and durable completion without manual database repair

findings.body: The proof list claims this test verifies unique provider sessions, but it checks only provider call counts, admission records, tool counts and outbound messages. It never checks provider session identities or conversation-specific model context. For example, reusing one Claude resume ID across every Claude conversation would still produce the mock's fixed replies and satisfy these assertions. Verify that provider sessions are distinct across conversations and remain scoped to their conversation on the second round, for both mocked providers.
findings.title: Not done: unique provider sessions in concurrent conversations

stop.reason: The user requested correction of the CI import boundary and a refreshed review. Remaining work is limited to the corrected checkpoint fixture and the existing session-isolation assertions; no findings are accepted or waived.

why: The inline runtime integration test bypasses durable live admission and cannot prove the full worker path
